description.text: The last set of the Diamond & Pearl series, released on 5 November 2008 with 106 cards: 100 numbered, three secret reprints of the Charmander, Charmeleon and Charizard of the early sets, and three Shiny holos numbered SH1 to SH3 (Drifloon, Duskull and Voltorb). Those Shiny cards, alternate-color Pokémon under their ordinary names, began a subset that returned in Platinum, Supreme Victors and Arceus. Its theme decks, Dark Rampage and Raging Sea, are built around Tyranitar and Gyarados, its Pokémon LV.X include Dusknoir and Machamp, and it brought in Trainer cards that grow stronger when played in pairs.

description.text: The copy with the "Prerelease" stamp, the promo card given to players at the Stormfront prerelease tournaments, held in North America on the weekends of 25–26 October and 1–2 November 2008. Players also got a pack of 60 Dusknoir card sleeves.

tell.text: The Prerelease stamp plus the word "STAFF", for the people who ran the Prerelease events.

description.text: The staff copy, with the "Prerelease" stamp and a "Staff" stamp, given to those who ran the Stormfront prerelease tournaments, held in North America on the weekends of 25–26 October and 1–2 November 2008.
